strong_write: `L2H14` is the earliest retained head-level reader inside the 24-node circuit.
`MLP11` is the first stable delivery-object writer.
`MLP11 -> MLP16 -> MLP19` is the earliest strong amplification segment for the shared file-vs-answer direction.
`L20H5 -> L21H12 -> L24H6 -> MLP27` is the cleanest late writer bridge for that shared object axis.
`MLP27` remains the primary late writer for `<tool_call>`.
`L16H4 -> MLP17 -> L23H6` is the suppressive no-tool chain.
`L16H4` reads user-side ordinary-answer evidence concentrated in the task-body / tail-suffix region rather than tool schema tokens.
`MLP17` also disturbs the late tool ingress route.
medium_write: `L2H14` already carries a weak shared file-vs-answer component, but it is not the first stable writer.
`L21H1` remains part of the late tool route overall, but it is not the cleanest monotonic carrier of the shared file-vs-answer direction.
`L23H6` is best described as a late suppressive relay rather than a main reader.
